stories.narrEn: Live Science reports: Early Wednesday (Nov. 18), NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft hit a new space exploration milestone: The probe, which launched in 1977, became the first spacecraft to reach one light-day from Earth. ScienceDaily reports: NASA’s Voyager 1 has reached an extraordinary milestone, traveling 16.1 billion miles from Earth to become the first spacecraft so distant that its signals take a full day to reach us. Space.com reports: PASADENA, Calif. – NASA's Voyager mission team cheered and wiped away tears here on Thursday (Nov. 19), celebrating a big milestone — Voyager 1 just reached one light-day from Earth , something no other spacecraft has ever done.

stories.narrEs: Según Proceso Digital (Honduras), el Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo (TAS) dio este martes la razón a Senegal y confirmó a su selección como campeona de la Copa África de Naciones de este año, en respuesta a su recurso contra la decisión de la Confederación Africana de Fútbol (CAF) de anular su victoria en la final y declarar campeón a Marruecos. De acuerdo con El Nacional (Venezuela), el tribunal con sede en Lausana falló a favor del recurso presentado por la selección senegalesa, luego de que la Confederación Africana de Fútbol le otorgara el trofeo por 3-0 al combinado marroquí en marzo.
stories.narrEn: According to Africanews, senegal were reinstated as winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations on Tuesday, after a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport. According to Sky News, senegal have been awarded the Africa Cup of Nations title after successfully appealing against the decision to strip them of it. According to AllAfrica, the CAS verdict sets aside a previous decision by the CAF Appeal Board to strip Senegal of the trophy after an appeal from the Royal Moroccan Football Federation. According to Euronews, the sport's top court ruled that the referee's decision to restart the final after Senegal's walk-off could not be challenged, while Morocco has raised questions over alleged contact between one of the judges and Senegal's federation.
